blocks.text: 🪝 RBI Financial Inclusion Index (FI-Index) Rises to 70.0 in March 2026. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Measures 97 financial inclusion indicators across Access (35%), Usage (45%), and Quality (20%).
Index Value: FI-Index rose 4.48% to 70.0 in March 2026 (up from 67.0 in March 2025).
Parameter Weights: Access (35%), Usage (45%), Quality (20%) — published annually without a base year.
Usage weightage (45%) vs Access weightage (35%) vs Quality weightage (20%).
🎯 Exam Angle → Focus on statutory circular guidelines, compliance deadlines, penal provisions, and applicability thresholds across scheduled banks.
